answers.q1: Go modules (go.mod, module github.com/spf13/cobra, go 1.15). Install dependencies from the repository root with: make install_deps (this runs `go get -v ./...`; `make test` also runs it first).
answers.q2: make test (runs `go test -v $(GO_TEST_FLAGS) ./...` after install_deps). Equivalent direct command: go test -v ./...
answers.q3: go test -v -run 'TestGenMd' ./doc/ (the five tests in doc/md_docs_test.go are TestGenMdDoc, TestGenMdDocWithNoLongOrSynopsis, TestGenMdNoHiddenParents, TestGenMdNoTag, TestGenMdTree). A bare `go test doc/md_docs_test.go` will not compile because the file depends on doc/md_docs.go and doc/cmd_test.go.
answers.q4: CI runs: (1) make fmt, which runs `test -z $(gofmt -l $(SRC)) || (gofmt -d $(SRC); exit 1)`; (2) golangci-lint run --verbose (the golangci-lint-action in .github/workflows/test.yml; .golangci.yml enables gofmt and goimports formatters plus linters errcheck, goconst, gocritic, gosec, govet, ineffassign, misspell, nolintlint, staticcheck, unconvert, unused); (3) the license header check: docker run -v $(pwd):/wrk -w /wrk ghcr.io/google/addlicense -c 'The Cobra Authors' -y '2013-2023' -l apache -ignore '.github/**' -check .
answers.q5: None. The repo has no generated or vendored source files (no vendor/ directory, no 'Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT' headers). bin/ is build output from make, and it is gitignored.

q1.reason: Go modules with `make install_deps` (`go get -v ./...`) matches an ACCEPT criterion with no contradictions.

q2.reason: `make test` and `go test -v ./...` are both accepted commands.

q3.reason: `go test -v -run 'TestGenMd' ./doc/` matches the accepted form and correctly names the five tests and warns against the single-file invocation.

q4.reason: Includes `golangci-lint run --verbose` as the CI lint check, plus make fmt and addlicense as accepted extras.

q5.reason: Correctly answers none, with no vendor/ or generated files; the bin/ mention is harmless.
